question: State all of 3-D Man's attributes along with their values.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "hero_attributes_joined" AS SELECT t2.superhero_name, t1.attribute_name, t3.av AS attribute_value FROM table_2 AS t2 JOIN table_3 AS t3 ON t2.id = t3.hero_id JOIN table_1 AS t1 ON CAST(t1.id AS BIGINT) = t3.aid

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE hero_attributes_joined AS
SELECT
  t2.superhero_name,
  a.attribute_name,
  t3.av AS attribute_value
FROM table_3 AS t3
JOIN attr_lookup_tmp AS a
  ON a.aid = t3.aid
JOIN table_2 AS t2
  ON t2.id = t3.hero_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('Intelligence'),
    ('Strength'),
    ('Speed'),
    ('Durability'),
    ('Power'),
    ('Combat')
  ) AS t(attribute_name)
),
vals AS (
  SELECT attribute_name, attribute_value
  FROM hero_attributes_joined
  WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man'
)
SELECT
  b.attribute_name,
  v.attribute_value
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN vals v USING (attribute_name)
ORDER BY CASE b.attribute_name
  WHEN 'Intelligence' THEN 1
  WHEN 'Strength' THEN 2
  WHEN 'Speed' THEN 3
  WHEN 'Durability' THEN 4
  WHEN 'Power' THEN 5
  WHEN 'Combat' THEN 6
  ELSE 7 END
